task.title: Applying a Chroma Key Filter
task.shortdesc: Remove a solid-color background from a camera source.

taskbody.prereq: A single, evenly lit solid-color backdrop behind the subject.

step.cmd: Right-click the camera source and choose Filters.
Under Video Filters, click + and choose Chroma Key.
Set Key Color Type to match your backdrop color.
Adjust Similarity and Smoothness until the background disappears cleanly without eating into the subject.

taskbody.result: The backdrop becomes transparent, letting whatever is in scenes beneath it show through.
